name: Partial Cubes Satisfy the Factorwise Product Theorem
statement: For finite connected graphs $G,H$, the product $G\square H$ is a partial cube if and only if both $G$ and $H$ are partial cubes.
proof: Products of irredundant cube embeddings give the forward closure. Conversely, every factor layer is convex in the product, so a partial-cube product has partial-cube factors.
